measurementLane: Synthetic actual-browser WebGPU API benchmark using SwiftShader SOFTWARE GPU. No hardware GPU, game or FPS measurement.

environment.gpuLane: Linux Chrome SwiftShader SOFTWARE GPU; no hardware-GPU timing claim
environment.scheduling: background throttling disabled; each target brought to front before its sample

results.sampling: alternating baseline/patch page order; same browser instance/software adapter, identical harness source; browser encoding wall and queue-completion wall kept separate

before.benchmark: actual production nonchunked shared-source WriteTexture on real browser WebGPU device; synthetic 3840x2160 R8 Y plane
before.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/158.0.8127.88 Safari/537.36
correctness: SAB 2D-array full+partial write exact readback
staged then direct ordering exact readback
BC7 array encoded blocks exact readback
source SAB overwritten immediately after actual writeTexture call; original GPU pixels retained
all 8,294,400 Y-plane bytes exact final readback
before.unmeasured: game/movie decoding, actual runtime producer, drawing, gameplay, FPS; completion wait is wall-clock queue fence latency, not GPU timestamp execution time
